summary: This figure gives an overview of BurstCBS, a burstable cloud block storage package running on a Data Processing Unit (xDPU). The diagram is split into two explicitly labeled boxes. The left 'SA Data Plane' box contains an FPGA driving several parallel SA Control Thread units. Dashed lines fan from those threads into the right 'SA Control Plane' box, which stacks BurstCBS's three key components named directly in the paper text: High-Perf Queue Scaling, Burstable I/O Scheduler, and Vectorized I/O Cost Estimator. Solid and hollow arrows lead from these components to two labeled outcomes, inter-thread load balance and intra-thread scheduling, showing how the control plane's software logic governs the data plane's hardware threads. Peach, yellow, and green fills distinguish the three control-plane components, while blue marks the FPGA data plane.
summary_zh: 该图展示 BurstCBS：左侧 SA Data Plane（FPGA 驱动多个控制线程）经虚线连接右侧 SA Control Plane 三个组件，分别驱动线程间负载均衡与线程内调度。
